svg.title: A gold star is not a proof
svg.desc: Two copies of a page of 100 sums. The benchmark test checks five sums, misses three wrong sums and gives a gold star. Loupe checks every sum and finds the three wrong sums. Each wrong sum is a witness that you can replay.
svg.text: A gold star is not a proof
The same page of 100 sums, with two ways to check it.
THE BENCHMARK TEST: CHECKS A FEW SUMS
Each red sum is a witness:
replay it to see the bug.
In the study, a sum is one input to a chip design. A formal tool checks all inputs, at every clock step.
